I had not long climbed into the mouth of the deep when I discovered the source of the sounds! Close to the entrance cowered a heavily armed giant of a man, fear written plainly in his every feature.
His voice shook as he warned me, "Deep within the cave dwells an evil, terrible monster, the most fearsome beast I have seen in all my years as a dragon slayer! It is so heinous and hideous to look upon that all who see it are turned rigid with fright!"
Though his teeth chattered with fear, he insisted on accompanying me as I continued nervously ...
Find the monster in the maze and face it!

Die Bestie, vor der sich der Franke so gefürchtet hatte, war besiegt!

Am Abend, als die Methumpen kreisten, erzählte ich ihm von unserer Mission. Sofort war er Feuer und Flamme, und bestand darauf, uns zu begleiten, war er doch ein waschechter Drachentöter!
Ich kniff die Augen zusammen und betrachtete ihn im Flammenschein genauer - ER WAR ES! Er war einer der Helden, die ich in meiner Vision gesehen hatte!

The beast that the Frank had been so afraid of had been defeated!
The city's inhabitants were able to sleep peacefully once more. I thanked the proud Frank, who had proven a true hero after all, for his help, and invited him to our village.
In the evening, as we drank a few mugs of mead, I told him of our mission. The dragon slayer at once insisted on accompanying us!
I screwed up my eyes and studied him by the light of the fire - IT WAS HIM! He was one of the heroes I had seen in my vision!
